Rout is 2.4× short. The circuit topology is fine; the shortfall comes from bias. M2 sits only 69 mV above Vdsat, so its gm/gds is about 52, and that degrades the cascode Rout. Compliance has a lot of margin (0.11 V measured against a 0.26 V limit). Raising R pushes Vds1 up and is the strongest lever on Rout (+31% per +10% change in R). Longer L also helps.
